name: Jonathan
overview: Jonathan was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Jada (1 Chronicles 2:32). The biblical record provides limited additional details about his life beyond this familial connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Jonathan means 'gift of YHWH,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning common in Hebrew names. This proper name was not given directly by God but is recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:32.
familyAndRelationships: Jonathan is explicitly recorded as the son of Jada (1 Chronicles 2:32). Inferred from the genealogical context, Peleth and Zaza are also identified as his ancestors (1 Chronicles 2:33). Scripture does not provide further family details beyond these relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Jonathan's importance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah as the son of Jada. While the biblical text offers limited narrative about him, his inclusion in the genealogical record underscores the continuity of God's chosen people. His name, meaning 'gift of YHWH,' points to the recognition of divine blessing within his lineage.
